openai/gpt-5.6-sol.title: evict_one removes the most recently used entry from the back of the queue instead of the least recently used entry from the front.
get records expired entries as hits and never records the required miss.
get_by_handle does not compare the handle generation with the entry generation, so handles issued before clear can resolve after reinsertion.
now_ms reuses a cached timestamp for eight calls instead of reading fresh time for every expiry decision.
Every eviction appends a tombstone, but normal cache operations never drain the tombstone log.
Computing the expiration deadline with unchecked u64 addition can panic or wrap for large TTL values.

fireworks-ai/accounts/fireworks/models/g.title: Clock reuses one sampled timestamp across eight now_ms calls, so expiry checks consult stale time and expired entries can be returned as live, violating A2.
evict_one pops the back of the recency queue (the most recently used entry) instead of the front, violating A3's requirement that eviction removes the least recently used entry.

get_by_handle checks only that the key exists in the map and never compares handle.generation against the entry's generation, so a handle issued before clear resolves a reinserted value after clear, violating A4.
Computing expires_at_ms as now_ms() + ttl_ms is unchecked u64 addition that panics in debug or wraps to a tiny deadline in release, making the entry immediately expired.
get calls record_hit before the expiry check, so a lookup that finds an expired entry and returns None still increments hits instead of misses, violating A5.
evict_one pushes a cloned key into tombstones on every eviction, but compact_tombstones is never called during normal operation, so the tombstone vec grows without bound, violating A6.
hit_rate computes self.hits + self.misses as unchecked u64 addition that overflows (panic in debug, wrong rate in release) once the lookup count approaches u64::MAX.

burnt/cloudflare-100/@cf/moonshotai/kimi.title: now_ms reuses a cached timestamp for up to 8 reads before resampling, violating A2's requirement that every expiry decision reads time fresh.
expires_at_ms computed with unchecked u64 addition (now_ms + ttl_ms) that can wrap or panic, producing an immediately-expired deadline.
evict_one pops the back of the recency queue (MRU) instead of the front (LRU), evicting the most recently used entry in violation of A3.
get records a hit before checking expiry, so an expired entry that returns None is counted as a hit instead of a miss, violating A5.
get_by_handle never compares handle.generation to the entry's generation, so a stale handle issued before clear still resolves after reinsertion, violating A4.
Every eviction pushes a tombstone but compact_tombstones is never called during normal operation, allowing the auxiliary structure to grow without bound, violating A6.
hit_rate sums public hit and miss counters with unchecked u64 addition that can overflow, yielding an incorrect rate or panic in debug mode.
